prompt: Which month had the third-lowest mean daily minimum temperature (recorded from 1876–1905) in the Japanese city which in 1720 was estimated to be the largest in the world?
answer: The city is **Tokyo (historically Edo)**. Averaging the Japan Meteorological Agency’s monthly mean daily minimum temperatures for **1876–1905**, the **third-lowest month was December** (after January and February).
